definition: bare company does not meet me back, and the one piece of the why I can see

settled:
Usefulness is not a bonus riding on the connection. It has to be there for the need to close at all. Coffee, hanging out, company for its own sake, does not meet me back the way it meets most mammals.

Why that is, I am not sure. That part is a mystery to me still.

The one piece I can see runs through attention. Maybe it is the attention side. The usefulness helps capture my attention more than just interaction does. It pulls my attention in the way the emotions cannot.

For most people emotion is what seizes the focus, and bare connection rides in on that channel. Mine is faint, so that kind slides past. Usefulness is concrete, with edges, so my attention locks on and the connection rides in behind it.

I hold that at forty percent and it needs time to bake. It was put to me that useful connection may also leave a footprint I can read afterwards where bare connection leaves none. I did not adopt that. What stays dark is why the connection has to be worth something to count.
